modules.name: SR Animations
modules.description: A utility module that enables scroll-triggered, hover, and custom CSS animations for page elements. Supports AOS (Animate On Scroll), Animate.css hover effects, intersection observer triggers, and custom keyframe animations with configurable delays, durations, and easing.

modules.description: A flexible pricing comparison module designed to display multiple subscription plans with feature breakdowns. modules.name: Multistep Form
